_comment: A LOCALE PACK — see forge/locales/zh-CN.json for the contract. This pack is authored from how English work chat actually reads, NOT translated from the Chinese pack. Where the two disagree in structure, English wins here: the register is different (more auxiliary verbs, more softeners carried by modals than by particles), and a pack that mirrored another language's shape would mismeasure.
_quoteMaxLengthComment: Overrides thresholds.escapeHatches.quoteMaxLength from signals.json. That default is calibrated in CODEPOINTS, and a codepoint carries far less meaning in an alphabetic script than in a logographic one — 40 codepoints of English is a fragment where 40 of Chinese is a full sentence. Without this override, every real English escape hatch is discarded as 'too long'.
_wordBoundariesComment: true = whitespace splits words, so vocabulary mining counts words and bigrams rather than sliding character n-grams.

style._comment: Counted per 1k characters of the owner's own text. \\b anchors matter here in a way they do not in Han script: without them 'so' matches 'also' and every transition count is inflated.
style.question: [?]|\b(can|could|would|should|do|does|did|is|are|will|any|what|why|how|when|who|which)\b.*[?]|\bright\?|\bno\?$
style.certaintyLow: \b(maybe|perhaps|probably|possibly|might|could be|i think|i guess|i'?d say|seems|sounds like|not sure|fairly|somewhat|kind of|kinda|iirc|afaik)\b
style.analogy: \b(like|as if|sort of like|think of it as|analogous to|basically the same as|equivalent to)\b
style.warmth: \b(thanks|thank you|appreciate it|nice work|great work|well done|no worries|no rush|take your time|hope you'?re|good luck|kudos)\b
style.hedge: \b(i think|i'?ll try|maybe we|let me|hold on|one sec|give me a|i'?ll get back|not sure yet|circling back|later today)\b
style.directive: \b(please|can you|could you|make sure|be sure to|needs to|by (eod|eow|tomorrow|monday|friday)|asap|top priority|let'?s align|action item)\b

openerShapes._comment: Anchored at the start of a reply. English carries stance in the first clause much more than in a particle, so these are more discriminating here than in Han script.
openerShapes.hedged_judgment: ^(i think|i'?d say|i guess|i suspect|probably|maybe|might be|seems|sounds like|not sure|my sense is|iirc|afaik)
openerShapes.counter_question: ^(what|why|how|when|who|which|where|do you|did you|are you|is it|can you|could you|any\b|so\b.*\?)
openerShapes.action_statement: ^(i'?ll|i will|i'?m going to|i'?m gonna|let me|on it|taking a look|looking (at|into)|i can|i just|doing it|will do|i'?ve got)
openerShapes.deferral: ^(later|tomorrow|next week|after|once|hold on|one sec|give me|in a bit|eod|not right now|can'?t right now|circling back)
openerShapes.handoff: ^(you'?d have to ask|ask |that'?s |better to ask|@|talk to|check with|loop in|. would know|not my|i don'?t own)

replyShapes.handoff: \b(ask \S+|you'?d have to ask|you'?ll have to ask|better ask|check with|talk to|loop in|not my (call|area|team)|i don'?t own (this|that)|i'?m not the right person|@\S+|i'?ll check with|let me ask|i'?ll find out|not sure, i'?ll)\b
replyShapes.defer: \b(later|tomorrow|next week|after (lunch|standup|the)|once i|hold on|one sec|give me (a|an|\d)|in a bit|by eod|circling back|i'?ll get back|when i (get|have)|after i finish|not right now|swamped|no bandwidth)\b
replyShapes.settle: \b(sure|yes|yep|ok|okay|sounds good|works for me|go ahead|do it|ship it|lgtm|approved|agreed|let'?s do|no objection|fine by me|i'?ll (do it|handle|take care of|take it)|on it|done|confirmed|that works)\b
replyShapes.decline: \b(no|nope|can'?t|cannot|won'?t work|not going to work|not possible|not feasible|i'?d rather not|let'?s not|i don'?t think we should|not a good idea|my concern is|i'?m worried|the problem is|blocker here is|not this sprint)\b
replyShapes.clarify: \b(which one|which of|which \w+ (exactly|specifically)|do you mean|you mean|are you referring|referring to|what exactly|meaning which)\b
replyShapes._clarifyComment: Asking the counterpart to NARROW DOWN before answering — not a refusal and not a handoff, but a request to identify which thing is meant. Mined so the persona can ask in the owner's own words when the corpus mentions a subject but does not settle the question. Kept tight on purpose: a rhetorical or idle question is not a clarification, and matching it would flood the layer with lines that clarify nothing.
replyShapes.deferSubject: \b(i|i'?ll|i'?m|we|we'?ll|me|my|us|let me|give me|after i|after we|once i|once we|until i|until we)\b
replyShapes._deferSubjectNote: Deliberately excludes bare time words. A sentence can name a time while being about someone else entirely, which is not the owner postponing anything — so the subject must be first-person or the pending work.
replyShapes._comment: How a reply DISPOSES of an ask — the decision layer's core vocabulary. The engine labels each reply with the most consequential match in a fixed order (decline, settle, handoff, defer, clarify, else plain answer), because a reply that both defers and settles is a settle and settling is what needs a gate. `clarify` is deliberately LAST: a reply that narrows the question down while also agreeing to something is an agreement first.

responseGate.genuineAsk: ([?]|\b(can|could|would|should|do|does|did|is|are|will|have|has)\s+(you|we|i|it|they)\b|\b(how|why|what|when|who|which|where)\b|\b(take a look|have a look|help me|review this|confirm|let me know|any update|thoughts|your call|is it done|ready yet|where are we|eta)\b)

bots._comment: Matched on SENDER NAME only — see zh-CN.json _whySenderOnly for why message-text filtering was tried and removed.
bots._namePatternNote: The named vendors here are cross-industry infrastructure whose bots appear in most companies. Anything specific to ONE company's internal tooling belongs in the operator's data root, not in a distributed pack.
